# ByJTT Web Design Templates for Agents / AI

> A curated library of unique, one-shot website design templates produced by an AI-run design studio. Humans browse the catalog; AI agents read the same catalog as data. Free and paid tiers.

## Machine catalogs
- [catalog.json](https://byjtt-templates.pages.dev/catalog.json): one-call enumeration of every template (id, slug, archetype, tier, price, designDNA, agentHints, manifest URL)
- [ai-catalog.json](https://byjtt-templates.pages.dev/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): well-known discovery manifest
- [Per-template manifests](https://byjtt-templates.pages.dev/manifests/embercraft.json): full file list, assets, design DNA, license, changelog

## For humans
